name: HC31: Non-suppressed ART clients that completed IAC sessions with 3 consecutive good adherence scores
description:
Number of non-suppressed active ART clients who completed an IAC course with three consecutive IAC sessions documenting good adherence, with the third qualifying session completed during the reporting period.
The patient must have a valid prior VL result classified as non-suppressed with is_unsuppressed = 1 and is_suppressed = 0, must be active on ART, and must have three sequential IAC sessions with no intervening IAC session between them; all three sessions must have good adherence, currently identified by adherence_code containing good or score &amp;gt;= 95, and the third consecutive good session must fall within the reporting period. The good-adherence values should still be confirmed against the actual values stored in mamba_fact_non_suppressed_obs_group.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT g1.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_non_suppressed_obs_group g1

JOIN mamba_fact_non_suppressed_obs_group g2
  ON g2.patient_id = g1.patient_id
 AND g2.session_date > g1.session_date

JOIN mamba_fact_non_suppressed_obs_group g3
  ON g3.patient_id = g1.patient_id
 AND g3.session_date > g2.session_date

WHERE g1.adherence_code = 'GOOD ADHERENCE'
  AND g2.adherence_code = 'GOOD ADHERENCE'
  AND g3.adherence_code = 'GOOD ADHERENCE'

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_non_suppressed_obs_group x
      WHERE x.patient_id = g1.patient_id
        AND x.session_date > g1.session_date
        AND x.session_date < g2.session_date
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_non_suppressed_obs_group x
      WHERE x.patient_id = g2.patient_id
        AND x.session_date > g2.session_date
        AND x.session_date < g3.session_date
  )
  AND g3.session_date >= :startDate
  AND g3.session_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_non_suppressed_card n
      WHERE n.patient_id = g1.patient_id
        AND n.encounter_date <= g3.session_date
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = g1.patient_id
        AND v.result_status = 'VALID'
        AND v.is_unsuppressed = 1
        AND v.is_suppressed = 0
        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date
            ) <= g1.session_date
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = g1.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
